power.neoorigins.wraith_hunger_drain.des: Idokwa ahụ gị dị egwu na-atụ ụtụ - ị na-agwụ agụụ 75% ngwa ngwa karịa ka ọ dị.
power.neoorigins.wraith_evolved_phase.de: Gbanwee: jiri ụgbọ elu na-aga n'okporo ụzọ siri ike mgbe ị na-agba ọsọ. 25% na-ebelata agụụ. Obsidian na bed ka na-egbochi gị.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_weaknes: Ndị iro nọ nso n'ime ngọngọ 3 nwere adịghị ike.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_dayligh: Ìhè anyanwụ ka na-ere ọkụ, ma na ọkara nke ike.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.name: Ụdị Spectral (Apex)
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.descr: Tụgharịa: gagharịa n'akụkụ niile ma e wezụga akwa akwa na ụgbọ elu ka ị na-aga. Obere igbapu agụụ. Ọ nweghị ihe nwere ike ibu gị.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_hunger_drai: Ụdị nlegharị anya gị akwụsịla - agụụ na-agbapụta naanị 25% ngwa ngwa karịa ka ọ dị.
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.name: Ọkpụkpụ
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.description: Akpa ọkpụkpụ azụgharịrị - ngwa ngwa, ọkụ, na egbu egbu na ụta. Ọkụ na-esighi ike, anyanwụ na-ezere ya, na-enwekwa ike ịbata nri ndị kacha njọ.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.name: anwụghị anwụ
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.descrip: Ị anwụghị anwụ. Ọgwụ ọgwụgwọ na-ewute gị, ọgwụ na-emerụ ahụ na-agwọ gị, na mgbaasị Smite na-emebikwa gị.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_water_breathin: Ọ dịghị mkpa iku ume. Nwere ike ịdị ndụ ruo mgbe ebighị ebi n'okpuru mmiri.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_marksmanship.d: +2 ego mmebi na ngwa agha projectile.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.name: Ìhè ọkpụkpụ
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.descript: Ọkpụkpụ oghere gị na-eme ka ị 20% ngwa ngwa n'ụkwụ gị.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.name: Dị fechaa
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.descripti: Malie 30% dị elu karịa nke nkịtị.
Ọkpụkpụ gị na-esighi ike na-ebelata ahụ ike gị ruo n'obi 7.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_daylight_damag: Ị na-ere ọkụ na ìhè anyanwụ kpọmkwem ma ọ bụrụ na i yi okpu agha.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.name: Nri enweghị ọkpụkpụ
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.descripti: Ị nwere ike iri naanị nri ọkpụkpụ, anụ rere ure, na anya ududo.
origins.neoorigins.slime.name: Slime
origins.neoorigins.slime.description: Anụ gelatinous nke ga-anọrịrị mmiri ka ọ dị ndụ. Ọpụpụ na-adaba n'enweghị ihe ọ bụla, na-ekewapụ n'ọnwụ mgbe mmiri dị mma, ma na-esiwanye ike site na ahụmahụ.
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.name: Mmiri
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.descript: Ị nwere mmiri mmiri na-asọpụta ka oge na-aga. Na-agbapụta ngwa ngwa n'ọzara na mgbe ọkụ. Guzo n'ime mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo ka ị nweta mmiri. N'elu 75%: Regen 1. N'okpuru 10%: -4 ngwa agha. Na 0%: ị na-emebi.
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.name: Kewaa
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.descri: Mgbe ị ga-anwụ na mmiri karịrị 75%, ị na-ekewa kama - teleporting 50 blocks pụọ na obi abụọ. Max HP gị na-amaliteghachi azụ na nkịtị karịa nkeji 2.
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.name: Uto Gelatin
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.descript: + 1 max HP kwa ọkwa ahụmịhe 10. Na-emegharị na ọnwụ.
power.neoorigins.slime_no_fall_damage.de: Ị na-adịghị ọdịda mebiri - ị ibiaghachi.

power.neoorigins.abyssal_apex_hp.name: Apex Vitality
power.neoorigins.abyssal_apex_conduit_po: Na-eku ume mmiri na-adịgide adịgide, ọhụụ abalị, na ngwa ngwa - na ala na n'okpuru mmiri.
